HabitatMech.scope: Current live Chrome/Playwright audit of all 24 criteria, with retained page states/screenshots, identifier and label search, facets/sort/reset and URL reload, fresh and resized 390px checks, cross-page theme checks, fault injection and reload recovery, sampled populated details, and separate complete-index coverage proofs. search.note: Identifier ENVO:03000033 finds one habitat and marine sediment finds three. The water query reports 310 matches but exposes only 200 search results; the category listings are separate routes.

facets.note: The grounding filter reduces the water query from 310 to 86 matches. Keyboard activation of Reset filters restores the initial unfiltered category listing.

result_counts.note: Counts change with identifier, label, unmatched-query and grounding-filter inputs; displayed results are distinguished from matching records when capped.

sorting.note: All five sort choices were exercised with the water query; the leading habitat changed between assertions, ascending/descending name, and grounding orders.

shareable_state.note: The identifier query restores after reload. Combined water search, grounding=EXACT and grounding sort also restore the same controls and 86 matches.

full_catalogue.note: Eight linked category indexes contain 3,209 distinct habitat slugs. Category pages expose paginated listings beyond the separate 200-result global-search cap.

record_pages.note: Marine sediment and aquatic macrophyte-associated environment open at stable habitat URLs with source attestations, environmental context and their own YAML links.

term_links.note: Marine sediment links its ENVO identity, while the Associated taxa section displays names and NCBITaxon CURIEs without ontology-resolver anchors. TaxonMech exploration links do not replace those resolver links.

evidence.note: Marine-sediment mechanistic-edge PMID references and curation DOI citations are displayed as plain text rather than PubMed/DOI links.

review_status.note: Record views show workflow status; the landing reports 1,301 REVIEWED records and explicitly distinguishes workflow status from human review.

curation_history.note: Marine sediment displays dated, attributed causal-graph creation/update and source-synonym/parent decisions, including the change explanations.

source_link.note: The sampled marine-sediment Provenance section links its own data/habitats/aquatic/marine_sediment.yaml source file.

domain_view.note: The semantic text map renders the 3,209-record projection, and the marine-sediment detail displays its directed causal graph.

cross_mech_links.note: Record exploration links to TaxonMech/browse.html and TraitMech/browse.html return HTTP 404; the correct browsers live under pages/. These handoffs do not resolve to specific sibling records.

corpus_stats.note: The landing displays 3,209 habitats, 2,143 ontology-grounded records, 175 corroborated by at least two sources and 1,301 with REVIEWED workflow status.

category_browse.note: Eight named category links lead to subset listings, including Aquatic with 468 records and Host-associated with 1,655.

suite_nav.note: All Mech projects links on the sampled templated landing, browse and record pages lead to the central suite directory, which returns HTTP 200.

downloads.note: The landing links all eight category JSON indexes and the complete semantic projection with its manifest. These retain 3,209 compact rows/points, rather than full habitat records.

schema_docs.note: Visible schema links open the annotated LinkML YAML and imported schemas. The sampled navigation supplies schema source rather than a rendered schema reference.

license.note: Templated pages state CC BY 4.0 data, BSD-3-Clause code and retained upstream terms, matching deployed-revision license files. The linked standalone text-map-source page omits these project licenses.

build_provenance.note: Main footers date the upstream kg-microbe extraction. The linked manifest dates the semantic projection, but sampled main pages do not identify a dated build or commit of the habitat corpus.

theme_toggle.note: Dark mode selected on the landing persists across templated pages. The linked standalone semantic map retains its light presentation without a theme control or theme attribute.

responsive.note: The aquatic-macrophyte record widens the document to 404px at a 390px viewport on fresh and resized loads. The other seven sampled routes fit.

load_failure.note: Blocking Browse category-index requests and searching reports Showing 0 of 0 matching habitats without an error. Removing the fault and reloading restores the one matching habitat.
